title: Service band in Manila and basic training
summary: He toured the Philippines with a service band, trained at Camp Livingston and played blues on the ship crossing.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Where was this? Hmm? Where was this?
Yeah, across the seas, that's right. That was like the year 43.
Where did you get your basic training?
I got my basic training, you know, right here in Cape Livingston, Louisiana. How about that? Yeah, right out there, 17 miles on the other side of Alexander, Louisiana.

And, well, I was sent to California. That's where I went cross sea from there, Camp Stormy. And we had a time all our way going cross sea. I was playing the blues for the bars. You know, they keep pianos on them old ships, you know. Man, we played the blues going cross sea. Yes, I did.
